tasks.DefineVariables: Define the variables for Denali's dogs (D_Denali) and Nate's dogs (D_Nate).
tasks.SetEquation1: Formulate an equation based on the first condition where Denali starts walking 4x more dogs.
tasks.SetEquation2: Formulate an equation based on the second condition where x of Nate's dogs are reassigned to Denali.
tasks.SolveSystemOfEquations: Solve the system of equations formed by Equations 1 and 2.
